name: hu-transfer-pricing
description: Hungarian transfer pricing (szokásos piaci ár, transzferár) for tax year 2026: companies and Hungarian branches that deal with related parties. Covers who is related (more than 50% majority influence, common control, PEs, shared management), the arm's length adjustment both ways under Tao. tv. 18. §, the interquartile range and median rule, the new documentation decree 45/2025 (XII. 23.) NGM that replaced 32/2017 from tax year 2026 (local file above HUF 150 million, master file above HUF 500 million, simplified file for low-value services at 5%), the small-enterprise exemption, the ATP data sheets in the corporate tax return, the local business tax (HIPA) follow-on, penalties up to HUF 5 million per missing record, APA fees, country-by-country reporting at EUR 750 million, and MAP. Trigger phrases: transzferár, szokásos piaci ár, kapcsolt vállalkozás, transfer pricing Hungary, fődokumentum, helyi dokumentum, ATP-01. Out of scope: hu-corporate-tax (rate, base, filing), hu-income-tax, hu
